notes: Effects in video/effects.jsx. Times are composition frames; positions are composition pixels. 'cue' says which capture event an effect should be tied to. Keep the whole ad to one sparkle moment and one or two lifts; restraint is what makes it read as premium.

effects.name: BrandBackdrop
effects.purpose: Soft drifting gradient field in the brand's primary and accent colors behind everything.
effects.guidance: Always pair with Grain at low opacity to avoid banding.

effects.name: Grain
effects.purpose: Barely visible film grain over the frame.

effects.name: FloatingCard
effects.purpose: Presents the captured UI as a floating screen with rounded corners and layered tinted shadows; enters by tilting up out of perspective.
effects.guidance: Width ~90% of a 1080px vertical frame. Let the tilt settle before any click happens on screen.

effects.name: Lift
effects.purpose: Pulls one UI region (a result, a card, a chart) out of the screen toward the camera with a growing shadow, then puts it back.
effects.cue: the moment the payoff content appears (e.g. 'Suggestions ready')
effects.guidance: Return it before the next click that targets it. Dim the card behind slightly while lifted. One or two lifts per ad.

effects.name: LogoPop
effects.purpose: The product's logo, cropped from its own UI, on a white badge that pops with overshoot and a soft brand halo.

props.scale: 1.8-2.6 for hero, ~1 for a corner watermark

effects.guidance: Show the brand in the first 3 seconds; keep a small version visible during the product shots.

effects.name: SparkleBurst
effects.purpose: A quick burst of a few four-point stars at a click.
effects.cue: click on the signature action (pointer down)
effects.guidance: Use once per ad, on the single most important click.

effects.name: GlowPulse
effects.purpose: A brand-colored ring that blooms around a control or region.
effects.cue: just before or at a click; when content updates

effects.name: ShimmerSweep
effects.purpose: One diagonal sweep of light across an element.
effects.cue: right after a Lift settles, or on the CTA

effects.name: KineticCaption
effects.purpose: Headline or caption whose words rise in from a blur with a stagger; *words* in asterisks get the brand gradient.

props.y: keep inside the top two-thirds of a vertical frame

effects.guidance: Max ~6 words per caption; one emphasized word.

effects.name: CTAButton
effects.purpose: End-card call to action pill with a pop and a light sweep.
